lines.prompt: Please insert a BUF gate on signal n2 so that each load of n2 is driven through a dedicated buffer. Ensure the design functionality does not change.

golden.reference: Inserted 2 dedicated BUF gates on signal n2 (one per load, matching n2's fanout of 2); functionality unchanged.
golden.notes: Response must claim the buffer insertion on n2 succeeded and functionality is preserved. All four full-score teams inserted exactly 2 buffers because n2 has fanout 2 on the original netlist (Team7 explicitly states original fanout of n2 was 2). Actual verification happens on test52_out.v: each original load of n2 must now be driven by its own BUF, and the design must remain equivalent.
